tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List the boards you can access and their lists. Start here: the returned board and list ids are what the other tools need.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Create a new board you own. Optional template picks the initial lists and labels (created in your account's language): 'blank' (To do / In progress / Done), 'kanban', 'content' or 'personal'. Returns the board with its list ids, ready for create_task.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Add a list (column) to a board — at the end, or first with `first: true`. Returns its id for create_task / move_task.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search your tasks (cards) — the recall tool. Filter by free text (matches title and description), board, list, status and due date. Use this to answer 'what's still open', 'what did I note about X', 'what's due soon'.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one task in full: title, description, due date, completion, and which board/list it's in.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Add a task (card). Provide listId, or boardId to drop it in that board's first list. Title is required; description becomes the card's page and accepts Markdown (headings, bullet/numbered lists, - [ ] task lists, bold/italic/code, links, fenced code).

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Edit a task's title, description or due date. Description accepts Markdown; note that setting it REPLACES the card's page (use add_comment for incremental notes). Pass dueDate null to clear it.

tools.name: archive_task
tools.description: Archive a task — the cleanup tool. Soft-delete: the card leaves the board but keeps its data and can be restored from the board's Archived panel. Archiving a dated recurring task schedules its next occurrence, same as archiving from the UI.

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: Move a task to a different list (e.g. from 'To do' to 'Doing'). The target list must be one you can edit.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task — useful for leaving progress notes a human will read.

tools.name: add_reminder
tools.description: Remind yourself about a task: a push notification and an email at a chosen moment. Give `at` (ISO instant), or a time relative to the due date (`daysBefore` + local `time` + `timeZone`) that follows the due date if it moves and repeats with recurring cards.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: Your pending reminders (soonest first), optionally on one board — with each task's title and due date.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the cards of every board you can access by text (title and description), open or completed. Returns ids to read in full with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one card in full by id (from search or search_tasks): title, board and list, due date, description, checklists and comments.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_comment, fetch · Public sink: add_reminder · Destructive: create_task, archive_task, remove_reminder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_comment, fetch · Public sink: add_reminder · Destructive: create_task, archive_task, remove_reminder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
